description_zh: 调用RestartInstances接口重启应用实例
name: RestartInstances

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the instances to be restarted. Separate multiple instance IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 需要重启的实例ID。多个实例时使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: instance_ids

Code.description_en:
The API status code or POP error code. Valid values:

2xx: Success.
3xx: Redirection.
4xx: Request error.
5xx: Server error
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code. Valid values:

Not returned: The request is successful.
Specific error code: The request fails. For more information, see the Error codes section in this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码列表

Message.description_en:
The additional information. Valid values:

success: The request is successful.
Specific error code: An exception occurred during the request
Message.description_zh:
附加信息。取值说明如下：

请求正常，返回success。
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Success.description_en:
Specifies whether the application instances were restarted successfully. Valid values:

true: The restart was successful.
false: The restart failed
Success.description_zh:
重启应用实例是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：重启成功。
false：重启失败

TraceId.description_en: The trace ID used to precisely query call information
TraceId.description_zh: 调用链ID，用于精确查询调用信息
